definitions.gloss: topcoat; final coat of paint or plaster
definitions.explanation: The outermost layer of paint, lacquer, or plaster applied over a base coat.
Attempting to conceal a mistake or wrongdoing, often making the situation worse. Used in the expression 嘘の上塗り (piling lies upon lies).

examples.japanese: ⟦{下塗|したぬ}り→下塗り：17437_shitanuri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{上塗|うわぬ}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Apply the topcoat after the base coat.

examples.japanese: ⟦{漆|うるし}→漆：10584_urushi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{上塗|うわぬ}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{美|うつく}しく→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧⟦{仕上|しあ}がった→仕上がる：11429_shiagaru⟧。
examples.english: The final coat of lacquer turned out beautifully.

examples.japanese: ⟦{壁|かべ}→壁：01290_kabe⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{上塗|うわぬ}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{乾|かわ}く→乾く：00786_kawaku⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{触|さわ}らないで→触る：00808_sawaru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please don't touch until the topcoat on the wall dries.

examples.japanese: ⟦{言|い}い{訳|わけ}→言い訳：04653_iiwake⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{恥|はじ}→恥：12636_haji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{上塗|うわぬ}りになった。
examples.english: The excuses only added to the embarrassment.

examples.japanese: ⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{隠|かく}そう→隠す：02034_kakusu⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧{上塗|うわぬ}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{重|かさ}ね→重ねる：02039_kasaneru⟧、⟦{事態|じたい}→事態：10151_jitai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧さらに⟦{悪化|あっか}した→悪化する：18844_akkasuru⟧。
examples.english: By piling cover-up upon cover-up to hide the failure, the situation got even worse.

notes:
USAGE:
Sense 1 is the literal meaning used in painting, lacquerwork, and plastering. Sense 2 is figurative, appearing in common expressions about compounding mistakes.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{嘘|うそ}→嘘：01796_uso⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{上塗|うわぬ}り (piling lies on lies)
- ⟦{恥|はじ}→恥：12636_haji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{上塗|うわぬ}り (adding shame to shame)
- {上塗|うわぬ}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{重|かさ}ねる→重ねる：02039_kasaneru⟧ (to pile on cover-ups)
- ⟦{下塗|したぬ}り→下塗り：17437_shitanuri⟧ → {中塗|なかぬ}り → {上塗|うわぬ}り (base → middle → topcoat)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{下塗|したぬ}り→下塗り：17437_shitanuri⟧: undercoat, base coat — the first layer
- {塗|ぬ}り⟦{重|かさ}ねる→重ねる：02039_kasaneru⟧: to apply coat after coat — neutral, no negative connotation
